notes.title: Update 7/25
notes.notes:
[h3]In this update, we intend to improve the overall stability of the game loop and quality of life.[/h3]

[list]
[*] We have improved connection stability to address a bug where players were sometimes stuck on the loading screen. 
[*] GD1 has been reworked. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera was clipping through the local player's body.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7/24 - 2
notes.notes:
[h3]In this update, we intend to finalize optimizations and address fatal bugs that caused crashes.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Temporarily removed the exit sign from the workbench due to it sometimes causing crashes when interacted with.
[*] Film grain has been removed to provide a clearer visual.
[*] Attempting to fix a bug where the player starts the mission and randomly experiences fatal crashes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 07/24
notes.notes:
[h3]In this update, we intend to finalize optimization for player equipment with some minor bug fixes.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the player's screen blurred
[*] More GD1 and Flashlight iteration optimizations
[*] Attempt to improve visual quality for spirit world effect
[/list]

notes.title: Update 07/22
notes.notes:
[h3]In this update, we intend to improve overall stability and performance and introduce new systems to support upcoming maps in the near future.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Main character optimizations to improve performance for multiplayer
[*] GhostEvents overall improvements
[*] Improved flashlight iteration performance
[*] Improved GD1 iteration performance
[*] Updated WhiteDress's hand spawn points
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7/20
notes.notes:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added sprint and stamina system.
[*]Increased Ghost Hunt's audio volume.
[/list]

[h1]QoL Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved FOV system to prevent camera clippings.
[*]Scroll wheel now can be used to swap between types of equipment.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed paranormal collisions that caused the player to stuck or pushed the player.
[/list]
